svg.aria-label: Energy Copilot: Ask your house how much the fridge costs. 11-node LangGraph agent: the LLM fills a query plan, code compiles it to parameterized SQL. sqlglot guard, read-only, one home; every number traces back to a query row. 11 skills, 25 tools on bge-m3 + pgvector HNSW: skill hit@1 1.0, tool P/R 0.786 / 0.964. Stack: Python, FastAPI, TimescaleDB, pgvector, LangGraph.
